# bunny

**Tag**: cli

## 简介

Easy to use, feature complete Ruby client for RabbitMQ 3.9 and later versions.

## 官网

- 主页: http://rubybunny.info
- 源码仓库: https://github.com/ruby-amqp/bunny/
- 更新日志: https://github.com/ruby-amqp/bunny/blob/main/ChangeLog.md
- RubyGems: https://rubygems.org/gems/bunny
